# Ecclesiastes Chapter 5 -- The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**5:1** Guard [shemor] your-foot [raglekha] when you-go [ka-asher telekh] to the-house of-God [beit ha-Elohim], and-draw-near [ve-qarov] to-hear [li-shmo'a] rather-than [mi-tet] the-fools' [ha-kesilim] giving [tet] of-sacrifice [zavach]; for they-do-not-know [einam yode'im] that-they-do evil [la'asot ra].

**5:2** Do-not-be-hasty [al te-vahel] with-your-mouth [al-pikha], and-your-heart [ve-libbekha] let-it-not-be-quick [al ye-maher] to-bring-out [le-hotzi'] a-word [davar] before God, for God [is] in-the-heavens [ba-shamayim] and-you [are] upon the-earth [al ha-aretz]; therefore let-your-words [devarekha] be few [me'attim].

**5:3** For the-dream [ha-chalom] comes [ba] with-much [be-rov] business [inyan], and-the-voice [ve-qol] of-the-fool [kesil] with-many [be-rov] words [devarim].

**5:4** When you-vow [ki-tiddor] a-vow [neder] to-God, do-not-delay [al te-acher] to-pay-it [le-shalmo]; for there-is-no pleasure [ein chefetz] in-fools [ba-kesilim]. What you-vow — pay [shallem]. **5:5** Better [tov] that you-should-not-vow [she-lo tiddor] than-that you-vow and-not pay [ve-lo te-shallem].

**5:6** Do-not-let your-mouth [pikha] cause-to-sin [la-chati] your-flesh [et-besarekha], and-do-not-say before the-messenger [ha-mal'akh] that it [was] an-error [shegagah]. Why should God be-angry [yiqtzof] at your-voice [al-qolekha] and-destroy [ve-chibbel] the-work of-your-hands [ma'aseh yadekha]?

**5:7** For in-many [be-rov] dreams [chalomot] and-vanities [hevelim] and-many words [devarim harbeh] — rather [ki-im] fear [yerah] God [et-ha-Elohim].

**5:8** If oppression [osheq] of-the-poor [rash] and-robbery [ve-gezel] of-justice [mishpat] and-righteousness [va-tzedeq] you-see in-the-province [ba-medinah], do-not-be-amazed [al titmah] at the-matter [al ha-chefetz]; for [one] high [gavoha] over [a] high-one [me-al gavoha] watches [shomer], and-high-ones [gevo'him] over-them [alehem].

**5:9** And-the-profit [ve-yitron] of-the-land [eretz] is-in-all [ba-kol]: a-king [melekh] to-a-field [le-sadeh] is-served [ne'evad].

**5:10** The-one-who-loves [ohev] silver [kesef] will-not be-satisfied [lo yisba] with-silver, and-whoever loves abundance [hamon] — not [with] produce [tevuah]. Also this [is] vapor [havel].

**5:11** When-goods [ha-tovah] increase [bi-revot], those-who-eat-them [okheleiha] increase [rabbu]; and-what advantage [kishron] [is there] to-their-owner [le-ve'aleiha] except the-seeing [re'ut] of-his-eyes [einav]?

**5:12** Sweet [methuqah] [is] the-sleep [shenat] of-the-worker [ha-oved], whether he-eats [yokhal] little or-much [harbeh]; but-the-satiety [ha-sava] of-the-rich [le-ashir] does-not-allow-him [einennu manni'ach lo] to-sleep [li-shon].

**5:13** There-is a-grievous [cholah] evil [ra'ah] I-saw under the-sun: riches [osher] kept [shamur] by-their-owner [li-ve'alav] to-his-harm [le-ra'ato]. **5:14** And-those riches are-lost [ve-avad ha-osher] in-a-bad [ra] venture [be-inyan], and-he-begets [ve-holid] a-son and-there-is-nothing [me'umah] in-his-hand.

**5:15** As he-came-out [yatza] from-his-mother's-womb [mi-beten immo] naked [arom], he-returns [yashuv] to-go as-he-came; and-nothing [me'umah] he-carries [yissa] for-his-toil [ba-amalo] that-he-may-take [she-yolekh] in-his-hand.

**5:16** And-also this [is] a-grievous evil: exactly [kol-ummat] as he-came, so he-goes; and-what profit [yitron] [has] he who-toils for-the-wind?

**5:17** Also all his-days he-eats in-darkness [ba-choshekh] and-much [harbeh] vexation [ka'as] and-sickness [ve-choly'o] and-wrath [va-qatzef].

**5:18** Behold, what I have-seen [ra'iti]: [it is] good [tov], which [is] beautiful [yafeh] — to-eat and-to-drink and-to-see good in-all one's-toil that one-toils under the-sun, [in] the-counted days [mispar yemei] of-his-life that God has-given to-him, for it [is] his-portion [chelqo].

**5:19** Also every human [kol ha-adam] to-whom God has-given riches [osher] and-possessions [nekhasim] and-has-empowered-him [ve-hishlito] to-eat from-them and-to-take [la-se'et] his-portion and-to-rejoice [li-smoach] in-his-toil — this [is] a-gift [mattat] of-God.

**5:20** For he-will-not-much [lo harbeh] remember [yizkor] the-days of-his-life, because God keeps-him-occupied [ma'aneh] in-the-joy [be-simchat] of-his-heart [libbo].

---

## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.1 — "Guard your foot":** The singular *raglekha* (your foot) suggests careful, deliberate approach to worship. The contrast is between attentive listening and the fool's thoughtless sacrifice — quantity of religious activity vs. quality of attention.

**v.2 — "God is in the heavens and you are on the earth":** This statement of cosmic distance is not meant to alienate but to induce reverence. The same God who placed eternity in the heart (3:11) is transcendent — and therefore not to be addressed carelessly.

**v.20 — "God keeps him occupied in the joy of his heart":** The Hebrew *ma'aneh* can mean "answers" or "keeps busy." God's gift of enjoyment is itself the answer to the problem of life's brevity. The person who receives this gift does not brood over mortality.

*-- EMET*
